text:
Samira Ali: Titan Appliances & EdgeCloud SI want us to accept their 'metered_session' feed (session_id, start_ts, end_ts, total_bytes) and produce a "dry-run" invoice preview for entitlements weekly. They also asked for a prorated quota algorithm for partial-session billing. Who can own this flow? :wave:

Ben Torres: I'll take mapping + tariff logic. Clarify prorate rule: bill by seconds of session rounded up to the nearest minute, multiplied by measured throughput? Or bill based on bytes per session bucket?

Nate (Titan): We prefer per-byte billing at the session level. Sessions can span midnight and multiple bill periods. We also provide device_tier (small/standard/pro) per device in manifest.

Omar Khalid: Proposal: convert each session -> bytes, assign to the period(s) it touches using proportional split by seconds in-period. Example: 1h session crossing midnight with 30min in period A and 30min in period B -> split bytes proportionally. We keep raw_session_bytes and prorated_bytes in preview.

Samira Ali: Nice. Titan also wants a weekly reconciliation CSV and a fast diff that highlights entitlements with >0.5% unit delta or >$50 absolute delta. They want the dry-run delivered 3 business days before invoice GA.

Ben Torres: CSV schema suggestion: entitlement_id, sku, period_start, period_end, raw_sessions, raw_bytes, prorated_bytes, billed_units, unit_price_cents, line_total_cents, partner_reported_bytes, delta_pct, notes

Jill (Marketing): Marketing wants consumer labels ("Titan Appliance Bandwidth — Starter/Pro") and one-line descriptions. Please avoid internal metric names in marketing text. We also need two sample dry-run rows for review.

Omar Khalid: SQL-ish aggregation for proportional split (sketch):
```sql
WITH split AS (
  SELECT session_id, entitlement_id,
    GREATEST(LEAST(end_ts, period_end) - GREATEST(start_ts, period_start), 0) AS seconds_in_period,
    total_bytes
  FROM titan_sessions_staging
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT period_start, period_end FROM billing_periods WHERE id='{{period}}') p
  WHERE start_ts < period_end AND end_ts > period_start
)
SELECT entitlement_id,
  SUM(total_bytes * seconds_in_period / (end_ts - start_ts)) AS prorated_bytes,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS raw_sessions
FROM split
GROUP BY entitlement_id;
```

Ben Torres: We'll also include idempotency via session_id and require manifest with HMAC signature. Late arrivals allowed up to 72h; backfill job will recompute affected periods and emit a corrected preview.

Nate (Titan): 72h backfill OK. We'll provide replay tooling. Also note some appliances are offline and batch-uploaded; manifest must include file_checksum.

Samira Ali: Reconciliation runbook: 1) Shadow ingest for 7 days 2) Produce daily dry-run CSV at 03:00 UTC 3) Compute delta vs partner_reported_bytes and delta_pct 4) If a rolling 3-day window has >0.5% for an entitlement, open MP ticket and pause GA for that entitlement 5) If ingestion lag >2h for >5% entitlements, fallback to partner_reported for that billing window.

Ben Torres: I'll post a Python snippet for proportional split and a sample CSV row. Sample row example:
```
ent_789,TIT-BW-PRO,2026-03-08T00:00:00Z,2026-03-15T00:00:00Z,12,987654321,876543210,1023.45,150,153517,"partner_ok",-0.12%
```

Jill (Marketing): Thanks — please include friendly labels mapping in the CSV: internal_sku -> market_label. Marketing will draft listing copy once sample rows are in.

Omar Khalid: Monitoring: add alert if delta_pct >0.5% OR absolute cents delta >5000 for enterprise SKUs. Auto-open ticket and notify partner POC.

Samira Ali: Action items: Ben -> mapping + proportional-split lib + sample dry-run CSV by Tue EOD; Omar -> staging + backfill job by Wed; Jill -> market labels + draft copy; Nate -> send manifest spec + sample files. We'll reconvene after day 4 of shadow run. :calendar:
